spec_hint: Shows today's solar noon for your latitude, takes a ghost-aligned camera photo, stores frames locally, plays them back as a time-lapse.
Type hourly pay, tap clock in; a live counter shows money earned so far this shift, saved across reloads.
Top-down canvas game: steer an ant across a floor while shadows of feet grow and stomp; survive longer for higher score.
Paste text; only one line is highlighted and the rest dimmed; arrow keys or tap move the line down.
Camera or chosen photo shown through a dog-vision filter: two-colour dichromat palette and softened detail, side by side with normal view.
Pick local audio files; plays a random few-second clip, you type or choose the title from file names, keeps score.
Tasks with a due date sorted into four urgent/important boxes beside a month calendar showing each task colour-coded by box.
Set an alarm time; each snooze is shorter than the last (10, 5, 2, 1 minutes) until you must get up.
Type to-dos; they scroll across the screen as a full-width ticker, tap an item to tick it off.
List people with how often to contact each; shows who is overdue, tap to log a contact and reset the clock.
Canvas minigolf holes where you aim a pool cue, pull back for power and strike the ball; nine holes, stroke count.
Record humming from the microphone; detects pitch per note and plays it back as square-wave 8-bit melody you can save as WAV.
Add dated events; a timeline where today fills most space and next week, month, year compress logarithmically.
Type text, pick an animal; each letter becomes a synthesized moo, meow, chirp or woof sequence played aloud.
Paste a wall of text; splits it into paragraphs at topic shifts and sentence counts, copy the result.
Alarm whose snooze button flips a coin: heads you get ten more minutes, tails the alarm keeps ringing.
Board game with atom tiles (C, H, O, N); place them to form valid molecules, scored by bonds, vs a friend on one device.
Short puzzle game: you are an AI in a tiny robot with limited commands and sensors, escaping a lab room by room.
Small canvas game that starts monochrome pixel art and gains colour, smoothness and effects with each level cleared.
Pick any file; encodes its bytes as coloured block frames into a video, and decodes such a video back to the file.
Tap to play convincing phone-line static and dropouts through the speaker so you can bow out of a call.
Queue commands to a rover on a grid map; each command takes effect after a signal delay, reach targets without crashing.
Ghosts approach with symbols overhead; swipe the matching shape to banish them, unlock new spells between waves.
Canvas game: a salmon fry dodges predators and dams, grows, travels to sea and swims back upstream to spawn.
Small arcade game where typing digits of pi, e or the golden ratio unlocks cheats like invincibility or slow motion.
Type each beer's price, size and ABV; ranks them by price per litre and per unit of alcohol.
Type a list of things you love; at alarm time the page speaks them aloud one by one to wake you.
Pick a photo and colour count; outputs a printable numbered outline with a matching colour key.
Pick an audio file and an image; records a video of the still image with the audio track, saved as WebM.
Microphone level meter with a threshold slider; plays a high-pitched beep whenever the room goes over it.
Type expected income, deductions and your tax rates; shows the four quarterly payment amounts and due dates.
Type monthly data allowance, used so far and cycle reset date; shows how much you can use per day left.
Pick age range, interests and budget; filters a built-in list of gift ideas and shuffles suggestions.
Single-screen canvas game: steer a remote-controlled missile through wind and obstacles onto marked targets.
Playable 3D Rubik's cube on canvas that makes a random turn every few seconds while you try to solve it.
Turn-based grid stealth game: you and the guards move like chess pieces; reach the exit unseen.
Add jokes or ideas without seeing earlier ones; the whole list stays hidden until you choose to reveal it.
Add hobbies, log sessions with time and notes; shows totals, streaks and last-done per hobby.
Type dimensions; lists everyday objects of similar size from a built-in table, with a scaled drawing.
Define a relation between cells; typing in either side recalculates the other, like a two-way converter grid.
Shows nine generated faces; pick the closest to the one in your head, next generation mutates from it.
Big clock showing the current time rounded to the nearest 15 minutes, with option to round up or down.
Random typists generate letters live; shows the longest stretch matching a Shakespeare passage so far and attempts count.
To-do list with a hard cap you set; refuses new items until one is done, shows load as a fill bar.
Pick an audio file; renders it up to 8x slower with time-stretching and plays or saves the result.
Add people and chores, tap who did each one; shows each person's share percentage per week and over time.
Add options, pass the phone around to rank them; runs instant-runoff rounds and shows the winner.
Load the before photo; camera view shows it as a translucent overlay so you line up the after shot, then compare.
Notes app where each note can hold JavaScript snippets run on demand to transform or compute note text, all local.
Listens to microphone level; after a set seconds of silence plays a random comical synthesized sound.
Type text; renders it in handwriting style with each letter slightly varied in size, slant and stroke, save as PNG.
Pick a song and target length; choose sections to cut, joins them with beat-aligned crossfades, save as WAV.
Task list beside a week calendar; drag tasks onto days to schedule and back to the list to unschedule.
Add life goals with categories; tick them off with date and note, shows progress done versus left.
Set a savings goal and log deposits; a drawn pet grows and gets happier as the balance approaches the goal.
Type subscriptions with price, cycle and renewal date; shows monthly and yearly totals and what renews next.
Type current daily cigarettes and quit date; builds a spaced daily schedule tapering to zero, with next-allowed countdown.
Shows everything this page can read about your device: screen, language, time zone, hardware, fonts, with plain explanations.
Small platformer whose doors close on a timer, so every level can only be cleared by moving fast.
Make stacks of cards with text, drawings and buttons that link to other cards; browse mode and edit mode, saved locally.
Fly a ship toward light speed on canvas; scenery shows length contraction, Doppler colour shift and clock slowing.
List things that expire (passport, licence, insurance) with dates; sorts by soonest, warns ahead, exports calendar reminders.
Tap for a random two-minute productive task from a built-in list, filtered by energy level and where you are.
Branching dialogue scenes (small talk, joining a group, saying no); choose replies and see how the other person reacts.
Per-friend notes: likes, dislikes, important dates, what they said last time; searchable and saved locally.
Shows a random note on a staff; sing it, microphone checks your pitch and scores accuracy without needing an instrument.
Paste text; flags misspelled words and suggests fixes ranked by keyboard-neighbour typos using a built-in word list.
Add each child's activities with days, times and what to bring; shows today's and this week's plan per child.
Two-player board game on one screen with no win or loss: tiles shift and the board grows forever, turn by turn.
